_about: Hand-authored, cited conditions for components the component tables print as C (M26, ADR-017). Predicate over sibling components of the same repetition: '<n> populated', '<n> empty', 'repeated' (the field has more than one populated repetition), AND, OR, parentheses. When it holds and the component is empty the Validator reports conditionalComponentMissing. 'conformanceRules' carries the 'as of v2.7' family in the same language, applied as conformanceCondition and checked only on opt-in (M27). Applied by scripts/private/extract-datatype-components.py. NOT modelled, each with its reason: CNE.7 / CWE.7 / CF.7 / CSU.8 (v2.8.2 2.A.13.7: a version ID is required when .3 is anything other than an HL7nnnn table of HL7 type; needs a value-pattern term and a table-type lookup, and the spec's own v2.7+ examples supply .7 in 1 of the 13 values that would require it, so it could only ever join the opt-in tier); CNE.20 (the v2.8.2 sentence contradicts its own summary: '6 or 14 or 17'); HD.2 / HD.3 (the HD either-or rule already carries them); PL.6, XTN.8, CNN.9, EI.3 / EI.4, PPN.8 / XCN.8 / PPN.12 / XCN.12 (printed C with no condition stated). v2.7.1 (P10-2): its Chapter 2A prints the same 72 C components as v2.8.2, and every one's definition was read against the v2.8.2 text: 60 are word for word the same and 12 differ only in a cross-reference (CF.3, CF.6, CSU.4, CNN.8, CNN.9, CNN.11, PPN.9, XCN.9, XCN.10, XCN.13, XCN.22, XCN.23), so the 2.7.1 blocks carry the v2.8.2 rules each re-cited to the v2.7.1 sentence, and the NOT-modelled list above holds for v2.7.1 too.

The corpus holds one v2.7+ field with two XAD repetitions (STF-11, chapter 15); its second repetition is mis-delimited (city and state in one component, six components, the type code in XAD.6), so it is not a counter-example to the sentence. conformanceRules.reason: The 'as of v2.7' conformance sentences: a coding system name or OID when a code is valued (CWE / CNE / CF .3 .6 .12 .14 .17 .20, CSU .4 .7 .15 .18 .21), an assigning authority or jurisdiction when an identifier is valued (CX .4 .9 .10, XCN .9 .22 .23, PPN.9), a name type when a family name is valued (XCN.10), an identifier type when an identifier is valued (XCN.13), and one of address / local number / unformatted number in XTN (.4 .7 .12). Measured against the specification's own v2.7+ example messages (78 messages, version-consistent): CWE.3 / CWE.14 violated by 529 of 549 values, CNE.14 30 of 30, XCN.9 / .13 / .22 / .23 43 of 43, XTN.4 / .7 / .12 117 of 118, CX.4 / .9 / .10 115 of 185, XCN.10 37 of 43. Enforcing them as errors would reject the standard's own messages and, in practice, nearly all v2.7+ traffic. Applied by the extractor as conformanceCondition (M27): never checked by default, reported as conformanceConditionMissing only when ValidationOptions.conformanceConditionSeverity is set. Files CF / CSU families unobserved in the examples are grouped with their identical-text CWE counterparts.
